description: This file defines utility structures, functions, and checks for tensor argument validation within the ATen library used in PyTorch. It includes argument validation functions, tensor argument wrappers, and related utilities specifically for tensor shapes, sizes, and properties.

classes.name: TensorArg
classes.description: A wrapper for Tensor arguments, including its name and position, used for argument validation.

classes.name: TensorGeometryArg
classes.description: A wrapper for TensorGeometry arguments, providing similar validation support as TensorArg.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of TensorGeometryArg to an ostream.

methods.name: checkDim
methods.description: Checks that a tensor's dimension matches the expected size.

methods.name: checkDimRange
methods.description: Checks that a tensor's dimension falls within a specified range.

methods.name: checkSameDim
methods.description: Checks that two tensors have the same number of dimensions.

methods.name: checkContiguous
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is contiguous in memory.

methods.name: checkAllContiguous
methods.description: Checks if all tensors in the list are contiguous.

methods.name: checkSize
methods.description: Checks that a tensor has the specified size in a given dimension.

methods.name: checkSize_symint
methods.description: Checks tensor size with SymInt support.

methods.name: checkNumel
methods.description: Checks that a tensor has a specific number of elements.

methods.name: checkSameNumel
methods.description: Checks that two tensors have the same number of elements.

methods.name: checkAllSameNumel
methods.description: Checks that all tensors in the list have the same number of elements.

methods.name: checkScalarType
methods.description: Checks that a tensor's scalar type matches the expected type.

methods.name: checkScalarTypes
methods.description: Checks that a tensor's scalar type is within a list of allowed types.

methods.name: checkSameGPU
methods.description: Checks that two tensors are on the same GPU.

methods.name: checkAllSameGPU
methods.description: Checks that all tensors are on the same GPU.

methods.name: checkSameType
methods.description: Checks that two tensors have the same data type.

methods.name: checkAllSameType
methods.description: Checks that all tensors have the same data type.

methods.name: checkSameSize
methods.description: Checks that two tensors have the same size.

methods.name: checkAllSameSize
methods.description: Checks that all tensors in the list have the same size.

methods.name: checkDefined
methods.description: Checks if a tensor argument is defined.

methods.name: checkAllDefined
methods.description: Checks if all tensor arguments are defined.

methods.name: checkBackend
methods.description: Checks if tensors have the specified backend.

methods.name: checkDeviceType
methods.description: Checks if tensors are on the specified device type.

methods.name: checkLayout
methods.description: Checks if a tensor has a specified layout.

methods.name: maybe_data_ptr
methods.description: Returns a data pointer if the tensor is defined; null otherwise.

methods.name: check_dim_size
methods.description: Checks the size of a specific dimension of a tensor.

methods.name: computeStride
methods.description: Computes the stride for reshaping tensors.
